## Whispers predicts: Coritiba 1-2 Santos [...] Like his Brazil squad-mate Pedro Morisco, Santos holding midfielder Bontempo is not expected to recover in time, while Argentine winger Barreal must serve an automatic one-match suspension after picking up his third yellow card against Bragantino.

Forwards Miguelito, who is on international duty with Bolivia, and Gustavo Caballero, representing Paraguay, are also unlikely to return in time and are effectively ruled out. [...] Coritiba must now decide whether to continue exploring alternatives or stick with their interim arrangement under Guilherme Bossle, known as Guila, for the remainder of the campaign.

For Wednesday's encounter, Bossle will be without centre-back Rodrigo Moledo, who is sidelined with an unspecified injury, while Lucas Ronier is unlikely to feature again this year as he continues his recovery from a more serious knee problem.

data.title: Preview: Coritiba vs Santos - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
Neymar is available again after having his suspension reduced, while Gabriel Barbosa is expected to lead the attack after scoring 15 goals in the 2026 Campeonato Brasileiro.

Coritiba possible starting lineup:

Rangel; Tinga, Tiago Coser, Moledo, B. Melo; Gomez, Santos; Lavega, Josue, Lopes; Rocha

Santos possible starting lineup:

Diogenes; Rodinei, Arao, Peres, Escobar; Henrique, Oliva; Coutinho, Neymar, Everton; Barbosa [...] Santos will welcome back Willian Arao and Gonzalo Escobar, who have recovered from thigh injuries and returned to unrestricted training with the first team.

Thaciano has also resumed working with the squad, although Gabriel Brazao and Lucas Veríssimo remain sidelined, while Alvaro Barreal and Vinicius Lira are also unavailable.

Gabriel Bontempo, Miguelito and Gustavo Caballero have been away on international duty, leaving Cuca with some decisions to make when selecting his squad. [...] Coritiba will be without goalkeeper Pedro Morisco, who is away with the Brazil national team and is not expected to return to Curitiba in time for Wednesday's fixture, meaning Pedro Rangel is set to start between the posts.

Defender Jacy is also a doubt after suffering a knee problem against Internacional, with the centre-back still undergoing treatment and yet to return to full training, while Lucas Ronier remains unavailable after suffering a serious knee injury.
